name: yafl-mcp
description: Open-source YAFL client: the @yafldev/mcp MCP server and @yafldev/cli, plus the shared client-side crypto and transfer pipeline.

scripts.build: npm --workspace apps/mcp run build && npm --workspace apps/cli run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace packages/crypto run typecheck && npm --workspace packages/client run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/mcp run typecheck && npm --workspace apps/cli run typecheck
scripts.test: npm --workspace packages/crypto run test && npm --workspace apps/mcp run test
